features.name: share_comments_ending_with_question
features.definition: What proportion of the counter-argument comments end with a question mark?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as a JSON list of strings. If malformed/missing, return null. If the list is empty, return null. For each comment, strip trailing whitespace and trailing closing characters (any of ) ] " ' * _ ~ and >), then test whether the final character is '?'. Return the number of such comments divided by the total number of comments in the list (empty/whitespace-only comments count in the denominator and as not ending with a question). Pure literal check, no semantic filtering.

h0: share_comments_ending_with_question has no association with delta.
h1: A higher share_comments_ending_with_question is associated with a higher probability of delta.
note: Operational assumption: "end with a question" means the comment's final character (after trailing whitespace/closing punctuation/markdown) is '?'; this is a surface proxy for inviting reflection, and rhetorical vs genuine questions are not distinguished. Row-level share across comments is used since no per-comment outcomes exist; persuasiveness is the row's delta, so this is an association only. Comment order/timing unknown; comments may include text added after the outcome (e.g., delta announcements) and raw text is not outcome-free. Questions followed by trailing text such as signatures or edits are not counted.
